rules: Government alignment and institutional structure are date/campaign sensitive.
Species does not imply government membership or loyalty.
Occupation-era authority does not persist automatically after political change.

organizations.canonical_label_policy: Concrete historical intelligence-service names may be attached per era/source; membership remains knowledge-gated.
rules: Do not infer intelligence membership from Cardassian species or suspicious behavior.

organizations.era_validity: only when campaign history supports them
organizations.instance_model: Separate persistent organizations/cells created by represented events.
rules: Resistance membership is not backfilled before formation.
A resistant Cardassian remains distinct from Union government affiliation.

ai_guardrails: Do not invent intelligence affiliation or resistance membership.
Do not preserve obsolete occupation authority after World State changes.
Do not make every Cardassian an agent of the Union.
